cues: In maize, a recessive allele blocks chlorophyll.
Cross two green plants that both carry it, and seedlings come up three green to one white.
But the white seedlings cannot photosynthesise.
They die as soon as the food in the seed runs out.
text: Some alleles kill. In maize, a recessive allele blocks chlorophyll. Cross two green plants that both carry it, and seedlings come up three green to one white. But the white seedlings cannot photosynthesise. They die as soon as the food in the seed runs out.
